quarterly_data.signal: ASE's 2Q26 results release (6-K), customer concentration: on an ATM basis the five largest customers together accounted for approximately 44% of total net revenues in 2Q26 (43% in 1Q26) and one customer accounted for more than 10%; the top 10 customers contributed 60% (58% in 1Q26); customers that are integrated device manufacturers (IDMs) accounted for 41% (38% in 1Q26). On an EMS basis the five largest customers accounted for approximately 58% (64% in 1Q26), one customer more than 10%, and the top 10 customers 69% (71% in 1Q26). Customers are not named.
quarterly_data.figure: ATM: top-5 customers ~44%, top-10 60%, IDMs 41% of 2Q26 net revenues; one customer >10%

quarterly_data.signal: ASE's 2Q26 results release (6-K), ATM mix and capacity: ATM revenues by application were communication 41% (46% in 2Q25), computing 30% (27% in 1Q26, 24% in 2Q25) and automotive, consumer & others 29%; by type, bumping, flip chip, WLP & SiP 49%, wirebonding 24%, testing 19%, others 6% and material 2%. ATM equipment capex was US$1,646 million in 2Q26 (US$963 million in 1Q26). ASE had 8,348 testers (7,585 in 1Q26, 6,797 in 2Q25) and 24,815 wirebonders (24,926 in 1Q26). Total employees were 114,179 at June 30, 2026 versus 107,950 at March 31, 2026.
